title: EvidenceItem
description: Provenance attached to a dossier field. Every non-null dossier field must carry at least one EvidenceItem.

field_name.description: The dossier field this evidence supports

value.description: The raw value as extracted from the source

evidence_snippet.description: Verbatim snippet from the source supporting the value

confidence.description: high=structured API/official source; medium=strong secondary/multi-source; low=inferred/weak
